metadata.author: V2 expansion (subagent draft)
metadata.key_test: Effectiveness/voice split under one-party rule: does a composite P1 survive a high/rising P3/P4 + improving government-effectiveness profile paired with near-bottom voice? Pairs with Rwanda (case25) on the same measurement vulnerability. Falsified if low voice forces a fragility call that growth contradicts.
metadata.notes: Reference-based record (country_ref + years; no embedded indicators). Resolved scores are real MI v2 re-scores. Doi Moi 1986 -> 2024; scored ~1996 vs 2024. Split-profile case: high effectiveness, near-bottom voice.

pre_event.event_description: Decade into Doi Moi market reform under continued single-party (CPV) rule; rising state capacity and growth with minimal political pluralism.

Vietnam.notes: Inputs resolved live via mi.datasource (country_ref + year). WGI 2025-anchored 0-100; P1 composite kept (effectiveness/voice not decomposed, per the case25 architectural decision). Voice scores near the bottom while government effectiveness, regulatory quality and rule of law rise across the window.

a_trajectory_ranking.prediction: Stable positive consolidation; trajectory driven by effectiveness (rising P3/P4 + improving government effectiveness), not by voice
a_trajectory_ranking.basis: Composite P1 (capacity-led); high/rising complexity-capacity matching under a one-party developmental state
a_trajectory_ranking.falsification_condition: Stagnation or fragility despite rising effectiveness, OR political liberalization despite near-bottom voice

b_violence.prediction: Low near-term violence RISK; elevated latent succession/accountability risk only
b_violence.agency_note: Mod8: this predicts RISK, not AGENCY
b_violence.falsification_condition: Large-scale internal violence or state breakdown

d_failure_dimension.note: Most exposed to post-hoc coding bias
d_failure_dimension.falsification_condition: Failure driven by a capacity/effectiveness dimension instead of voice

f_reversal_risk.prediction: Latent reversal risk concentrated in the voice deficit; capacity trajectory positive

Vietnam.outcome_summary: Stable consolidation as predicted: MI 0.574 -> 0.603 (Tier 3 -> Tier 2), P1 0.404 -> 0.479. HDI 0.499 (1990) -> 0.766 (2023), about +53%; roughly 40 million people exited poverty 1993-2014. No regime breakdown; continued one-party rule with rising state capacity. Neither falsification condition met.

a_trajectory.explanation: Effectiveness-led positive trajectory realized under one-party rule; growth did not contradict the call. Composite P1 survived the split-profile case.

b_violence.evidence: No large-scale internal violence across the window
b_violence.explanation: Low near-term violence risk held; stability maintained.
b_violence.data_refreshed: 2026-06-28: focus=Vietnam pre-P1=0.404 -> MODERATE risk (MI v1, anchored)

d_failure_dimension.evidence: Voice/accountability remains the floor pillar; capacity rose
d_failure_dimension.explanation: Residual vulnerability sits on accountability as predicted, but no failure materialized; coded PARTIAL under strict standards (post-hoc dimension identification).
d_failure_dimension.computed_config: Vietnam: P5=0.73, P4=0.64, P3=0.61, P2=0.48, P1=0.40 | below-median (genuine vulnerabilities): P1=0.40, P2=0.48

f_reversal_risk.evidence: No liberalization; voice deficit persists; capacity trajectory positive
f_reversal_risk.explanation: Latent reversal risk in the voice dimension is real but un-triggered; directionally correct, magnitude indeterminate.

analysis.overall_assessment: Hard stress test passed: effectiveness-led composite P1 produced a correct stable-consolidation call despite near-bottom voice. Mirrors Rwanda (case25).
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: A second clean instance (with Rwanda) of the WGI effectiveness/voice collapse not breaking an ordinal P1 call when capacity drives the outcome; strengthens the case for the composite over a forced decomposition.
analysis.baseline_impact: None; composite P1 retained, consistent with case25.
analysis.phase3_note: Migrated to MI v1 + Data API references. a_trajectory/c_convergence auto-derived from real re-scored data (Mod4-gated); b/d/e/f/g/h preserved as judgment.
analysis.judgment_refresh_note: Judgment verdicts (b/d/e/f/g/h) re-examined against MI v1 real-data scores on 2026-06-28: no verdict flips (directional readings robust to the legacy->anchored vintage change); b risk-levels refreshed from real pre-P1, d augmented with the real config (weakest pillar flagged as a binding vulnerability only when below median), safeguards re-evaluated.
